tool.name: get_address
tool.title: Address information
tool.description:
Retrieve address information including current balance and transaction counts. Supports all standard Bitcoin address types (P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH, P2WSH, P2TR).

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address)*

REST operation: `GET /api/address/{address}`.

tool.name: get_address_confirmed_txs
tool.title: Address confirmed transactions
tool.description:
Get the first 25 confirmed transactions for an address. For pagination, request `GET /api/address/{address}/txs/chain/{after_txid}` with the last returned txid.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-transactions-chain)*

REST operation: `GET /api/address/{address}/txs/chain`.

tool.name: get_address_confirmed_txs_after
tool.title: Address confirmed transactions (paginated)
tool.description:
Get the next 25 confirmed transactions strictly older than `after_txid` (Esplora-canonical pagination form, matches mempool.space).

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-transactions-chain)*

REST operation: `GET /api/address/{address}/txs/chain/{after_txid}`.

after_txid.description: Last txid from the previous page (return transactions strictly older than this)

tool.name: get_address_hash_prefix_matches
tool.title: Address hash-prefix matches
tool.description:
Find addresses by address type and by the first 1-16 hex nibbles of RapidHash v3 over the raw address payload bytes. Intended for privacy-preserving client-side wallet discovery without sending raw addresses or xpubs. Fetch metadata with `GET /api/address/{address}`.

REST operation: `GET /api/address/hash-prefix/{addr_type}/{prefix}`.

prefix.description:
First 1–16 hexadecimal nibbles of the RapidHash v3 hash over the raw
address payload bytes.

tool.name: get_address_mempool_txs
tool.title: Address mempool transactions
tool.description:
Get unconfirmed transactions for an address from the mempool, newest first (up to 50).

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-transactions-mempool)*

REST operation: `GET /api/address/{address}/txs/mempool`.

tool.name: get_address_txs
tool.title: Address transactions
tool.description:
Get transaction history for an address, newest first. Returns up to 50 mempool transactions plus a confirmed page sized to fill the response to 50 total (chain floor of 25, so 25-50 confirmed depending on mempool weight). To paginate further confirmed history, request `GET /api/address/{address}/txs/chain/{after_txid}` with the last returned txid.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-transactions)*

REST operation: `GET /api/address/{address}/txs`.

tool.name: get_address_utxos
tool.title: Address UTXOs
tool.description:
Get unspent transaction outputs (UTXOs) for an address. Returns txid, vout, value, and confirmation status for each UTXO.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-address-utxo)*

REST operation: `GET /api/address/{address}/utxo`.

tool.name: get_block
tool.title: Block information
tool.description:
Retrieve block information by block hash. Returns block metadata including height, timestamp, difficulty, size, weight, and transaction count.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block)*

REST operation: `GET /api/block/{hash}`.

BlockHash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_block_by_height
tool.title: Block hash by height
tool.description:
Retrieve the block hash at a given height. Returns the hash as plain text.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-height)*

REST operation: `GET /api/block-height/{height}`.

tool.name: get_block_by_timestamp
tool.title: Block by timestamp
tool.description:
Find the block closest to a given UNIX timestamp.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-timestamp)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/blocks/timestamp/{timestamp}`.

tool.name: get_block_fee_rates
tool.title: Block fee rates
tool.description:
Get block fee rate percentiles (min, 10th, 25th, median, 75th, 90th, max) for a time period. Valid periods: `24h`, `3d`, `1w`, `1m`, `3m`, `6m`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y`.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-feerates)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/blocks/fee-rates/{time_period}`.

TimePeriod.description:
Time period for mining statistics.

Used to specify the lookback window for pool statistics, hashrate calculations,
and other time-based mining series.

tool.name: get_block_fees
tool.title: Block fees
tool.description:
Get average total fees per block for a time period. Valid periods: `24h`, `3d`, `1w`, `1m`, `3m`, `6m`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y`.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-fees)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/blocks/fees/{time_period}`.

TimePeriod.description:
Time period for mining statistics.

Used to specify the lookback window for pool statistics, hashrate calculations,
and other time-based mining series.

tool.name: get_block_header
tool.title: Block header
tool.description:
Returns the hex-encoded 80-byte block header.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-header)*

REST operation: `GET /api/block/{hash}/header`.

BlockHash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_block_rewards
tool.title: Block rewards
tool.description:
Get average coinbase reward (subsidy + fees) per block for a time period. Valid periods: `24h`, `3d`, `1w`, `1m`, `3m`, `6m`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y`.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-rewards)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/blocks/rewards/{time_period}`.

TimePeriod.description:
Time period for mining statistics.

Used to specify the lookback window for pool statistics, hashrate calculations,
and other time-based mining series.

tool.name: get_block_sizes_weights
tool.title: Block sizes and weights
tool.description:
Get average block sizes and weights for a time period. Valid periods: `24h`, `3d`, `1w`, `1m`, `3m`, `6m`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y`.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-sizes-weights)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/blocks/sizes-weights/{time_period}`.

TimePeriod.description:
Time period for mining statistics.

Used to specify the lookback window for pool statistics, hashrate calculations,
and other time-based mining series.

tool.name: get_block_status
tool.title: Block status
tool.description:
Retrieve the status of a block. Returns whether the block is in the best chain and, if so, its height and the hash of the next block.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-status)*

REST operation: `GET /api/block/{hash}/status`.

BlockHash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_block_tip_hash
tool.title: Block tip hash
tool.description:
Returns the hash of the last block.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-tip-hash)*

REST operation: `GET /api/blocks/tip/hash`.

tool.name: get_block_tip_height
tool.title: Block tip height
tool.description:
Returns the height of the last block.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-tip-height)*

REST operation: `GET /api/blocks/tip/height`.

tool.name: get_block_txid
tool.title: Transaction ID at index
tool.description:
Retrieve a single transaction ID at a specific index within a block. Returns plain text txid.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-transaction-id)*

REST operation: `GET /api/block/{hash}/txid/{index}`.

BlockHash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

BlockTxIndex.description:
Position of a transaction within a single block (0 = coinbase).
Distinct from `TxIndex`, which is the chain-wide global tx index.

tool.name: get_block_txs_from_index
tool.title: Block transactions (paginated)
tool.description:
Retrieve transactions in a block by block hash, starting from the specified index. Returns up to 25 transactions at a time.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-transactions)*

REST operation: `GET /api/block/{hash}/txs/{start_index}`.

start_index.description: Starting transaction index within the block (0-based)

BlockHash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

BlockTxIndex.description:
Position of a transaction within a single block (0 = coinbase).
Distinct from `TxIndex`, which is the chain-wide global tx index.

tool.name: get_block_v1
tool.title: Block (v1)
tool.description:
Returns block details with extras by hash.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-block-v1)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/block/{hash}`.

BlockHash.description:
Double-SHA256 block-header hash, serialized in Bitcoin's conventional
hexadecimal byte order.

tool.name: get_blocks
tool.title: Recent blocks
tool.description:
Retrieve the last 10 blocks. Returns block metadata for each block.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-blocks)*

REST operation: `GET /api/blocks`.

tool.name: get_blocks_from_height
tool.title: Blocks from height
tool.description:
Retrieve up to 10 blocks going backwards from the given height. For example, height=100 returns blocks 100, 99, 98, ..., 91. Height=0 returns only block 0.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-blocks)*

REST operation: `GET /api/blocks/{height}`.

tool.name: get_blocks_v1
tool.title: Recent blocks with extras
tool.description:
Retrieve the last 15 blocks with extended data including pool identification and fee statistics.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-blocks-v1)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/blocks`.

tool.name: get_blocks_v1_from_height
tool.title: Blocks from height with extras
tool.description:
Retrieve up to 15 blocks with extended data going backwards from the given height.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-blocks-v1)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/blocks/{height}`.

tool.name: get_cpfp
tool.title: CPFP info
tool.description:
Returns ancestors and descendants for a CPFP (Child Pays For Parent) transaction, including the effective fee rate of the package.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-children-pay-for-parent)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/cpfp/{txid}`.

tool.name: get_difficulty_adjustment
tool.title: Difficulty adjustment
tool.description:
Get current difficulty adjustment progress and estimates.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-difficulty-adjustment)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/difficulty-adjustment`.

tool.name: get_difficulty_adjustments
tool.title: Difficulty adjustments (all time)
tool.description:
Get historical difficulty adjustments including timestamp, block height, difficulty value, and percentage change.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-difficulty-adjustments)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/difficulty-adjustments`.

tool.name: get_difficulty_adjustments_by_period
tool.title: Difficulty adjustments
tool.description:
Get historical difficulty adjustments for a time period. Valid periods: `24h`, `3d`, `1w`, `1m`, `3m`, `6m`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y`.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-difficulty-adjustments)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/difficulty-adjustments/{time_period}`.

TimePeriod.description:
Time period for mining statistics.

Used to specify the lookback window for pool statistics, hashrate calculations,
and other time-based mining series.

tool.name: get_fullrbf_replacements
tool.title: Recent full-RBF replacements
tool.description:
Same response shape as `GET /api/v1/replacements`, but limited to trees where at least one predecessor was non-signaling (full-RBF).

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-fullrbf-replacements)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/fullrbf/replacements`.

tool.name: get_hashrate
tool.title: Network hashrate (all time)
tool.description:
Get network hashrate and difficulty data for all time.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-hashrate)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/hashrate`.

tool.name: get_hashrate_by_period
tool.title: Network hashrate
tool.description:
Get network hashrate and difficulty data for a time period. Valid periods: `24h`, `3d`, `1w`, `1m`, `3m`, `6m`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y`.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-hashrate)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/hashrate/{time_period}`.

TimePeriod.description:
Time period for mining statistics.

Used to specify the lookback window for pool statistics, hashrate calculations,
and other time-based mining series.

tool.name: get_historical_price
tool.title: Historical price
tool.description:
Get historical BTC/USD price. Optionally specify a UNIX timestamp to get the price at that time.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-historical-price)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/historical-price`.

tool.name: get_indexes
tool.title: List available indexes
tool.description:
Returns all available indexes with their accepted query aliases. Use any alias when querying series.

REST operation: `GET /api/series/indexes`.

tool.name: get_mempool
tool.title: Mempool statistics
tool.description:
Get current mempool statistics including transaction count, total vsize, total fees, and fee histogram.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mempool)*

REST operation: `GET /api/mempool`.

tool.name: get_mempool_blocks
tool.title: Projected mempool blocks
tool.description:
Projected blocks for fee estimation. Block 0 reflects Bitcoin Core's actual next-block selection; blocks 1+ are a fee-tier approximation.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mempool-blocks-fees)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/fees/mempool-blocks`.

tool.name: get_mempool_hash
tool.title: Mempool content hash
tool.description:
Returns an opaque hash that changes whenever the projected next block changes. Same value as the mempool ETag. Useful as a freshness/liveness signal: if it stays constant for tens of seconds on a live network, the mempool sync loop has stalled.

REST operation: `GET /api/mempool/hash`.

tool.name: get_mempool_recent
tool.title: Recent mempool transactions
tool.description:
Get the last 10 transactions to enter the mempool.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mempool-recent)*

REST operation: `GET /api/mempool/recent`.

tool.name: get_oracle_histogram_outputs
tool.title: Output value histogram at height or day
tool.description:
Unfiltered output value histogram for a confirmed point. A block height (`840000`) gives every output in that block, coinbase included, binned by value on the oracle log scale; a calendar date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) sums every block that day. A flat array of log-scale bins.

REST operation: `GET /api/oracle/histogram/outputs/{point}`.

point.description:
Confirmed block height as decimal digits (`840000`) or calendar date in
`YYYY-MM-DD` format.

tool.name: get_oracle_histogram_outputs_live
tool.title: Live output value histogram
tool.description:
Live unfiltered output value histogram for the forming mempool block. Every live output is binned by value on the oracle log scale; no oracle payment filters are applied. A flat array of log-scale bins, all zero when no mempool is configured.

REST operation: `GET /api/oracle/histogram/outputs/live`.

tool.name: get_oracle_histogram_payments
tool.title: Payment output histogram at height or day
tool.description:
Smoothed histogram of oracle-eligible payment outputs for a confirmed point. A block height (`840000`) gives that block's oracle payment histogram; a calendar date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) gives the average of that day's per-block payment histograms. A flat array of log-scale bins.

REST operation: `GET /api/oracle/histogram/payments/{point}`.

point.description:
Confirmed block height as decimal digits (`840000`) or calendar date in
`YYYY-MM-DD` format.

tool.name: get_oracle_histogram_payments_live
tool.title: Live payment output histogram
tool.description:
Live smoothed histogram of oracle-eligible payment outputs, binned by output value on the oracle log scale. It combines the committed oracle window with the forming mempool block. A flat array of log-scale bins.

REST operation: `GET /api/oracle/histogram/payments/live`.

tool.name: get_pool
tool.title: Mining pool details
tool.description:
Get detailed information about a specific mining pool including block counts and shares for different time periods.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pool)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/pool/{slug}`.

tool.name: get_pool_blocks
tool.title: Mining pool blocks
tool.description:
Get the 10 most recent blocks mined by a specific pool.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pool-blocks)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/pool/{slug}/blocks`.

tool.name: get_pool_blocks_from
tool.title: Mining pool blocks from height
tool.description:
Get 10 blocks mined by a specific pool before (and including) the given height.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pool-blocks)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/pool/{slug}/blocks/{height}`.

tool.name: get_pool_hashrate
tool.title: Mining pool hashrate
tool.description:
Get hashrate history for a specific mining pool.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pool-hashrate)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/pool/{slug}/hashrate`.

tool.name: get_pool_stats
tool.title: Mining pool statistics
tool.description:
Get mining pool statistics for a time period. Valid periods: `24h`, `3d`, `1w`, `1m`, `3m`, `6m`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y`.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pools)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/pools/{time_period}`.

TimePeriod.description:
Time period for mining statistics.

Used to specify the lookback window for pool statistics, hashrate calculations,
and other time-based mining series.

tool.name: get_pools
tool.title: List all mining pools
tool.description:
Get list of all known mining pools with their identifiers.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pools)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/pools`.

tool.name: get_pools_hashrate
tool.title: All pools hashrate (all time)
tool.description:
Get hashrate data for all mining pools.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pool-hashrates)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/hashrate/pools`.

tool.name: get_pools_hashrate_by_period
tool.title: All pools hashrate
tool.description:
Get hashrate data for all mining pools for a time period. Valid periods: `1m`, `3m`, `6m`, `1y`, `2y`, `3y`.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-mining-pool-hashrates)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/hashrate/pools/{time_period}`.

TimePeriod.description:
Time period for mining statistics.

Used to specify the lookback window for pool statistics, hashrate calculations,
and other time-based mining series.

tool.name: get_precise_fees
tool.title: Recommended fee rates (precise)
tool.description:
Recommended fee rates by confirmation target, with up to three decimal places and support for sub-sat/vB rates.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-recommended-fees-precise)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/fees/precise`.

tool.name: get_prices
tool.title: Current BTC price
tool.description:
Returns bitcoin latest price (on-chain derived, USD only).

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-price)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/prices`.

tool.name: get_replacements
tool.title: Recent RBF replacements
tool.description:
Returns up to 25 most-recent RBF replacement trees across the whole mempool. Each entry has the same shape as `tx_rbf().replacements`.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-replacements)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/replacements`.

tool.name: get_reward_stats
tool.title: Mining reward statistics
tool.description:
Get mining reward statistics for the last N blocks including total rewards, fees, and transaction count.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-reward-stats)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/mining/reward-stats/{block_count}`.

block_count.description: Number of recent blocks to include

tool.name: get_series
tool.title: Get series data
tool.description:
Fetch data for a specific series at the given index. Use query parameters to filter by date range and format (json/csv).

REST operation: `GET /api/series/{series}/{index}`.

start.description: Inclusive start: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end. Aliases: `from`, `f`, `s`

end.description: Exclusive end: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end. Aliases: `to`, `t`, `e`

limit.description: Maximum number of values to return (ignored if `end` is set). Aliases: `count`, `c`, `l`

Index.description:
Aggregation dimension for querying series. Includes time-based (date, week, month, year),
block-based (height, tx_index), and address/output type indexes.

Limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 100 if not specified.

RangeIndex.description: A positional index, YYYY-MM-DD date, or ISO 8601 timestamp.

tool.name: get_series_bulk
tool.title: Bulk series data
tool.description:
Fetch multiple series in a single request. Supports filtering by index and date range. Returns an array of SeriesData objects. For a single series, use `get_series` instead.

REST operation: `GET /api/series/bulk`.

start.description: Inclusive start: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end. Aliases: `from`, `f`, `s`

end.description: Exclusive end: integer index, date (YYYY-MM-DD), or timestamp (ISO 8601). Negative integers count from end. Aliases: `to`, `t`, `e`

limit.description: Maximum number of values to return (ignored if `end` is set). Aliases: `count`, `c`, `l`

Index.description:
Aggregation dimension for querying series. Includes time-based (date, week, month, year),
block-based (height, tx_index), and address/output type indexes.

Limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 100 if not specified.

RangeIndex.description: A positional index, YYYY-MM-DD date, or ISO 8601 timestamp.

tool.name: get_series_count
tool.title: Series count
tool.description:
Returns the number of series available per index type.

REST operation: `GET /api/series/count`.

tool.name: get_series_info
tool.title: Get series info
tool.description:
Returns the optional description, supported indexes, and value type for the specified series.

REST operation: `GET /api/series/{series}`.

tool.name: get_series_latest
tool.title: Get latest series value
tool.description:
Returns the single most recent value for a series, unwrapped (not inside a SeriesData object).

REST operation: `GET /api/series/{series}/{index}/latest`.

Index.description:
Aggregation dimension for querying series. Includes time-based (date, week, month, year),
block-based (height, tx_index), and address/output type indexes.

tool.name: get_series_len
tool.title: Get series data length
tool.description:
Returns the total number of data points for a series at the given index.

REST operation: `GET /api/series/{series}/{index}/len`.

Index.description:
Aggregation dimension for querying series. Includes time-based (date, week, month, year),
block-based (height, tx_index), and address/output type indexes.

tool.name: get_series_version
tool.title: Get series version
tool.description:
Returns the current version of a series. Changes when the series data is updated.

REST operation: `GET /api/series/{series}/{index}/version`.

Index.description:
Aggregation dimension for querying series. Includes time-based (date, week, month, year),
block-based (height, tx_index), and address/output type indexes.

tool.name: get_sync_status
tool.title: Sync status
tool.description:
Returns the sync status of the indexer, including indexed height, tip height, blocks behind, and last indexed timestamp.

REST operation: `GET /api/server/sync`.

tool.name: get_transaction_times
tool.title: Transaction first-seen times
tool.description:
Returns timestamps when transactions were first seen in the mempool. Returns 0 for mined or unknown transactions.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-times)*

REST operation: `GET /api/v1/transaction-times`.

txId[].description: Transaction IDs to look up (max 250 per request).

tool.name: get_tx
tool.title: Transaction information
tool.description:
Retrieve complete transaction data by transaction ID (txid). Returns inputs, outputs, fee, size, and confirmation status.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction)*

REST operation: `GET /api/tx/{txid}`.

tool.name: get_tx_by_index
tool.title: Txid by index
tool.description:
Retrieve the transaction ID (txid) at a given global transaction index. Returns the txid as plain text.

REST operation: `GET /api/tx-index/{index}`.

TxIndex.description:
Chain-wide transaction index (0 = the genesis coinbase). For an
in-block position, use `BlockTxIndex` instead.

tool.name: get_tx_hex
tool.title: Transaction hex
tool.description:
Retrieve the raw transaction as a hex-encoded string. Returns the serialized transaction in hexadecimal format.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-hex)*

REST operation: `GET /api/tx/{txid}/hex`.

tool.name: get_tx_merkle_proof
tool.title: Transaction merkle proof
tool.description:
Get the merkle inclusion proof for a transaction.

*[Mempool.space docs](https://mempool.space/docs/api/rest#get-transaction-merkle-proof)*

REST operation: `GET /api/tx/{txid}/merkle-proof`.

tool.name: get_tx_merkleblock_proof

tool.name: get_urpd
tool.title: Latest URPD
tool.description:
URPD for the most recent available date in the cohort. The response's `date` field echoes which date was served. Returns `{ cohort, date, weight, aggregation, close, total_supply, buckets }`. `close` and each bucket's `price_floor`, `realized_cap`, and `unrealized_pnl` are USD; `total_supply` and bucket `supply` are BTC. `unrealized_pnl` can be negative.

REST operation: `GET /api/urpd/{cohort}`.

agg.description: Aggregation strategy. Default: raw (no aggregation). Accepts `bucket` as alias.

Cohort.description:
URPD cohort identifier. Use `GET /api/urpd` to list available cohorts.

Validated at construction: non-empty, ASCII `[a-z0-9_]+`. Matches the
schemars enum value set; the type therefore proves "this is a valid
cohort name" wherever a `Cohort` is held.

UrpdAggregation.description:
Aggregation strategy for URPD buckets.
Options: raw (no aggregation), lin200/lin500/lin1000 (linear $200/$500/$1000),
log10/log50/log100/log200/log500/log1000/log2000 (logarithmic with 10/50/100/200/500/1000/2000 buckets per decade).

UrpdWeight.description: Weighting applied to a URPD: raw (unweighted), cointime, or coinflow.

tool.name: get_urpd_at
tool.title: URPD at date
tool.description:
URPD for a (cohort, date) pair. Returns `{ cohort, date, weight, aggregation, close, total_supply, buckets }` where each bucket is `{ price_floor, supply, realized_cap, unrealized_pnl }`. `close`, `price_floor`, `realized_cap`, and `unrealized_pnl` are USD; `total_supply` and `supply` are BTC. `unrealized_pnl` can be negative.

REST operation: `GET /api/urpd/{cohort}/{date}`.

date.description: Calendar date of the URPD snapshot in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

agg.description: Aggregation strategy. Default: raw (no aggregation). Accepts `bucket` as alias.

Cohort.description:
URPD cohort identifier. Use `GET /api/urpd` to list available cohorts.

Validated at construction: non-empty, ASCII `[a-z0-9_]+`. Matches the
schemars enum value set; the type therefore proves "this is a valid
cohort name" wherever a `Cohort` is held.

UrpdAggregation.description:
Aggregation strategy for URPD buckets.
Options: raw (no aggregation), lin200/lin500/lin1000 (linear $200/$500/$1000),
log10/log50/log100/log200/log500/log1000/log2000 (logarithmic with 10/50/100/200/500/1000/2000 buckets per decade).

UrpdWeight.description: Weighting applied to a URPD: raw (unweighted), cointime, or coinflow.
